title: Heroes and minions
summary: Five minion classes with three minions each, plus three heroes. The first of each class is owned from the start; the rest are researched.

sections.title: Units
sections.note: Cost is in Summon Bubbles at Lv 1. Stats are Lv 1 base values. Attack timings are at normal speed.
rows:
Basic Defender minion.
Has high HP but relatively low ATK.
Has an advantage against ground-type close-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s

Advanced Defender minion.
Uses a protective barrier to safeguard its HP.
Has an advantage against ground-type close-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s
Barrier worth 20% of max HP for 5 s every 10 s

Advanced Defender minion.
Launches stronger attacks by wielding a shield.
Has an advantage against ground-type close-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s

Basic Attacker minion.
Has an excellent balance of HP and ATK.
Has an advantage against ground-type long-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s

Advanced Attacker minion.
Moves swiftly to the target's rear to perform sneak attacks, but cannot be used against towers and bosses.
Has an advantage against ground-type long-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s
Jumps behind its target (range 30) every 10 s

Advanced Attacker minion.
Launches powerful attacks using an ax.
Has an advantage against ground-type long-range Raptures.
Melee attack on one enemy every 1 s

Basic Gunner minion.
Has high ATK but relatively low HP.
Has an advantage against aerial-type Raptures.
Shoots one enemy, 3 hits every 1 s

Advanced Gunner minion.
Temporarily reduces the skill cooldown, allowing for quicker attacks.
Has an advantage against aerial-type Raptures.
Shoots one enemy, 3 hits every 0.5 s
Attacks 100% faster for 5 s every 10 s

Advanced Gunner minion.
Has a long shooting range and can attack from a greater distance.
Has an advantage against aerial-type Raptures.

Basic Bomber Man minion.
Has low HP but performs AoE attacks.
Lobs a shell at enemies in a circle (size 10) every 2 s

Advanced Bomber Man minion.
Performs AoE attacks and explodes when it dies, dealing damage to its surroundings.
Lobs a shell at enemies in a circle (size 10) every 2 s
Explodes on death, hitting enemies in a circle (size 10) for 100% of ATK

Advanced Bomber Man minion.
Performs AoE attacks and deals sustained damage to the area where the missiles explode.
Lobs a shell at enemies in a circle (size 10), 5 hits every 2 s; leaves a damaging zone for 3 s (ticks every 1 s)

Basic Healer minion.
Restores allies' HP.
Unable to attack any Raptures.

Advanced Healer minion.
Restores the HP of allies within the range.
Unable to attack any Raptures.
Heals allies in a circle (size 10) every 4 s

Advanced Healer minion.
Enhances the ATK or potency of HP recovery of allies within range.
Unable to attack any Rapture.
Raises ATK of allies in a circle (size 10) by 20% for 4 s every 1 s

A hero created based on Little Mermaid's image.
Once her trait is activated, she uses her special skill and uses bubbles to attack Raptures across the screen.
Attacks all Raptures and has an advantage against any type of Rapture.
Strike on enemies in a 7×11 area every 3 s
Special skill (needs a trait): hits every enemy on screen

A hero created based on Cinderella's image.
Once her trait is activated, she uses her special skill and uses Glass Slippers to attack all Raptures across the screen.
Attacks all Raptures and has an advantage against any type of Rapture.
Shoots enemies in a circle (size 10), 5 hits every 6 s; leaves a damaging zone for 3 s (ticks every 1 s)
Special skill (needs a trait): hits every enemy on screen

A hero created based on Abe's image.
Once her trait is activated, she uses her special skill to recover all heroes and minions on the screen.
Unable to attack any Rapture.
Heals allies in a circle (size 10) every 4 s
Special skill (needs a trait): heals every ally on screen by 50%

sections.title: Stat growth by level
sections.note: Multiplier on base ATK / HP (×1 at Lv 1). Levels are bought in battle with Summon Bubbles and reset after each battle; the stage sets the cap. Some hero values jump at Lv 11 and 21 and drop back after: that is how the table has them.
